scope: UNPUBLISHED Mind & Perception editorial, Zen12 eligibility and conversion experiment
evidence_limits: Public seller pages and published abstracts only; no actual affiliate account, checkout, product use, film, customer transaction or live A/B tested

sources.title: Rohde Di Luca Ernst, 2011 PLOS drift/ownership

claims.claim: Original 1998 report describes altered referral of tactile sensation to an artificial limb
claims.limits: Abstract available; do not fabricate incidence rates or precise sample counts.

claims.claim: Visual, tactile and proprioceptive signals can conflict in a rubber hand protocol
claims.limits: Experiment-specific. Not a universal description of normal ownership.

claims.claim: Proprioceptive drift is not a one-to-one ownership proxy
claims.limits: Rohde conditions and measurement protocol required.

claims.claim: Premotor cortex activity was associated with reported rubber-hand ownership
claims.limits: Neural correlate, not a whole-self localization or clinical result.

claims.claim: A 2022 psychophysical study favored a causal-inference account of ownership under manipulated visual noise
claims.limits: Model comparison in study, not proof all experiences use one process.

claims.claim: Lush 2020 found expectancy patterns challenging common ownership rating controls
claims.limits: Quasi-experiment tests demand characteristics, not falsification of all previous studies.

claims.claim: Puységur archives provide historical context for reported suggestion
claims.limits: No validation of animal magnetism as treatment.

claims.claim: Change blindness article and Focus page are established published destinations
claims.limits: Live visited via web 2026-11-08, provider success for opt-in unverified.

claims.claim: Inspire3 markets Zen12 and Hypnosis Live as related products
claims.limits: Seller relationship not evidence of named FV affiliate approval.

claims.claim: Zen12 Premium merchant describes 12 levels
claims.limits: Buyer delivery never audited.

claims.claim: Zen12 Premium merchant describes 48 MP3s
claims.limits: No independent download/test.

claims.claim: Zen12 seller offers four listening styles
claims.limits: Verify exact package at checkout.

claims.claim: Zen12 seller advertises one-year money-back
claims.limits: Refund exceptions, execution and jurisdiction unverified.

claims.claim: Zen12 seller asserts twelve minutes is equivalent to one hour's advanced meditation
claims.limits: Do not assert or imply as FV-verified efficacy.

claims.claim: Zen12 health and cognitive efficacy claims
claims.limits: No relevant independent product-specific controlled study established.

claims.claim: Displayed Zen12 Premium promotional price establishes final payable amount
claims.limits: Website displayed price Nov 8; does not authenticate checkout/currency/taxes/fees.

claims.claim: Hypnosis Live Total Focus seller describes a 33-minute 47 MB download
claims.limits: Other Hypnosis Live products have different features; do not substitute generic copy.

claims.claim: Hypnosis Live advertises 14-day refund with FAQ limits
claims.limits: FAQ caps refunded sessions annually; cannot generalize to Zen12 or claim zero risk.

claims.claim: Affiliate disclosure should be beside any active buying recommendation
claims.limits: Only prospective disclosure while inactive; require merchant-specific active review.

claims.claim: FV has named Inspire3 acceptance and permitted website/social/email channels
claims.limits: Gmail marketing messages do not establish publisher authorization; private portal not accessed.

claims.claim: Partner-issued tracking URL and cleared commission data available
claims.limits: No identifier, link or merchant-ledger evidence verified.

claims.claim: FV-owned paid Mind SKU rights and checkout established
claims.limits: Public inventory does not prove rights, payment processing or refund fulfillment.

claims.claim: Video version improves settled paid conversion over text-only guide
claims.limits: R218 variants are source-only; zero randomized paid observations.

claims.claim: Merchant email opt-in is a confirmed FV lead
claims.limits: Merchant newsletter distinct from existing Jetpack confirmed opt-in.

claims.claim: Rubber hand illusion establishes named audio-product efficacy
claims.limits: Research cannot be transposed to Zen12 or Hypnosis Live.

claims.claim: No-JS disabled CTA prevents authorizing affiliate redirects in this source version
claims.limits: Browser/WordPress sanitization still untested.

gates.criterion: Named Final Vestige publisher accepted by Inspire3
Email/Jetpack channel expressly permitted if used
Account-issued earning URL and redirect terms privately authenticated
Exact SKU, checkout total/currency/taxes and refund policy authenticated
Original source-specific efficacy evidence for proposed health claims
Real browser mobile, keyboard, screen reader and no-JS checks
42s playable rights-cleared film caption quality and perf budgets
Grok real published media IDs/hook/rights reconciled
Active existing Jetpack confirmed signups observable
Ledger paid orders/refunds/fees and qualified humans available
Single Mind canonical article/slug approved vs existing drafts
R210 video/text A/B not changed without experiment governance

conversion_contract.realized_net_formula: settled_owned_receipts + cleared_affiliate_commissions - refunds - transaction_fees - chargebacks - attributable_variable_costs
